user.title: Add an MWM infrared endpoint
user.description: Register what this endpoint does. Transmitters drive the MWM ear lights through an infrared emitter; receivers turn captured IR signals into diagnostic sensors.

hardware.title: Select the infrared entity
hardware.description: Pick the infrared emitter or receiver this endpoint is bound to.

abort.no_emitters: No infrared emitter entities are available. Set up an infrared proxy (e.g. ESPHome) first.
abort.no_receivers: No infrared receiver entities are available. Set up an infrared receiver first.
